reviewRounds.finding: OperationCase was described both as L1 and as forbidden without an L0 authority, leaving authority ownership contradictory.
reviewRounds.remediation: Separated immutable L0/O1 originals, event-sourced L1 OperationCase authority and rebuildable Workshop projections.

reviewRounds.finding: The plan named idempotency, SLA and kill but lacked classification decisions, policy-version acceptance, reversible split/merge, multiset conservation, SLA clock decisions and kill in-flight semantics.
reviewRounds.remediation: Added append-only decision types, successor/Diff rules, conservation equations, three kill checkpoints and unknown reconcile behavior.
